title: Decode Nested Bracket Repeats
prompt:
An encoded message contains lowercase letters and repeats written as `k[encoded]`, where the positive integer `k` repeats the text inside the brackets. Repeats can be nested or placed next to ordinary letters and other repeats. Implement `decode_bracket_repeats(encoded: str) -> str` and return the fully decoded message.

The input is valid. Its length is from 1 to 30 characters, each repeat count is from 1 to 300, and the decoded result has at most 100,000 characters. Numbers appear only as repeat counts immediately before `[`. A repeat count can have multiple digits.

example.reasoning: The bracketed text in the outer repeat is `acc`, so the result contains three copies.
